column1: # Tracked files copied VERBATIM into /etc (decisions/0008). The owning hook writes them
# (write-on-change, with a .bak); `dram doctor` compares each target with its source and
# names the hook to re-run. Templated files (reflector.conf, pacman.conf options, the
# ly/rEFInd configs) are not listed: their hooks own the comparison. TAB-separated:
# source (repo-relative), target, role (or pseudo-role: base, metal, wsl), owning hook.
